dataset: WASP-39 b transmission-spectrum baseline (real system parameters, illustrative band excess)
source: Baseline transit depth computed directly from real WASP-39 b / WASP-39 system parameters (planet radius, stellar radius) queried live from the NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP service. WASP-39b is the JWST target with the first confident exoplanet CO2 detection (JWST Transiting Exoplanet Community ERS Team, 2023). Molecular-band excess amplitudes layered on top of the real baseline are illustrative (not digitized from the published JWST spectrum) and are labelled as such.
citation: JWST Transiting Exoplanet Community Early Release Science Team, 2023. Identification of carbon dioxide in an exoplanet atmosphere. Nature, 614, pp.649-652.

archive_parameters.queried_from: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP (ps table, default_flag=1)

requiredCitations: Seager, S. and Sasselov, D.D., 2000. Theoretical transmission spectra during extrasolar giant planet transits. The Astrophysical Journal, 537(2), pp.916-921.
JWST Transiting Exoplanet Community Early Release Science Team, 2023. Identification of carbon dioxide in an exoplanet atmosphere. Nature, 614, pp.649-652.
